name: Conceptual Breakout

approval.notes: New proposed visual grammar. Canonical identity is approved, but this creative style has not been reviewed or approved by the user.

description: A high-concept visual surprise built around one material or object metaphor, oversized shapes and editorial tension; distinct from both photographic campaign grids and data-atlas diagrams.

source_of_truth.comment: Asya'da Eğitim has approved identity assets but no complete approved brand-system.md. These campaign choices are review-only.

hard_locks.identity: Exact pre-approved V-01 identity only; never reconstruct, redraw, typeset or transform a canonical lockup.

lockup_preference.interior: H-02/dark or H-02/light; P-01 when space allows; always use the exact approved complete SVG

hard_locks.typeface: Jost (campaign production family; not a new canonical brand typography approval)
hard_locks.copy: Preserve approved Turkish copy, official slogan and CTA exactly; no generated logo/wordmark text.
hard_locks.source: Editable HTML/CSS/SVG and actual browser PNG render; optional AI only as separately composited non-text, non-logo imagery.

soft_constants: Choose one understandable visual concept per story, not a miscellaneous collage of stock objects.
Use striking object scale, negative space or contrast for the first slide; reveal the information through changing compositions.
Maintain editable Jost typography and official canonical logo as a separate safe layer; never embed lettering in generated imagery.
Give every slide a role in the reveal rather than recycling the same poster.
Keep all visual metaphors truthful and culturally appropriate; decorative images do not impersonate a real university.

color_behavior.default_guideline_for_five_slides: Alternate quiet paper reveals and punchy ink or red moments without overwhelming text legibility.
color_behavior.contrast_rule: Identity logo uses approved contrast variant. Text remains visually legible on photographic/object treatments.
color_behavior.variation_rule: Change scale, material and visual framing; never treat recoloring as the entire style difference.

layout_grammar.sequence_rule: Create a concept-driven narrative arc (hook → reveal → detail → response) with at least three composition treatments; concept beats must remain coherent.
layout_grammar.text_fit: Large display type must coexist with legible body copy; do not force an overlong text into an art-poster treatment.
layout_grammar.media: Optional original/authorized object, collage or cutout layers only; brand typography/logo remain editable canonical assets.
anti_patterns: visual gimmicks that obscure accurate details

visual_metaphor.description: Central expressive device for the story.

materiality.description: Rendering/material treatment of supporting visual layers.

image_role.description: Images never include final brand typography or logos.

sequence_arc.description: How the concept unfolds through multiple slides.

object-metaphor.label: Nesne metaforu
object-metaphor.summary: An oversized meaningful object anchors a narrative; plenty of brand-safe type space.

typographic-shock.label: Tipografik gerilim
typographic-shock.summary: Bold Jost lettering and purposeful white space create a visual hook.

editorial-collage.label: Katmanlı kolaj
editorial-collage.summary: Controlled paper/photo cutouts and staggered layout reveal a story in stages.

required_checks: brand identity and chosen complete SVG lockup hashes verified against canonical manifest
actual HTML/CSS/SVG source preserved and Chromium/Playwright PNG raster verified at target size
legible Turkish copy, typography, contrast, line-wrap and logo clearspace checked on all slides
selected style's distinctive grammar and per-slide visual variety checked in a real render
brand-identity and creative human approvals remain distinct; no automatic publishing

evaluation.method: Compare same brief rendered in registered style families; check grammar distinction and shared approved identity.

preview_quality_contract.source_preference: Use verified assets and current original briefs. Historical candidate posts are not evidence this style was approved.

identity_gate.note: Complete outlined paths must be byte-for-byte identical to the canonical SVG record; brand name must not be a substitute HTML text block.

density_and_layout_gate.logo_positions: Can vary across safe, contrast-appropriate placements; each slide preserves clearspace.
density_and_layout_gate.image_usage: Use owned/authorized meaningful object cutouts or paper/material forms; generated image layers may not carry logo or text.
density_and_layout_gate.composition: Recognizable conceptual device and dramatic pacing distinct from the Editorial Campaign and the Data Atlas families.
density_and_layout_gate.visual_inspection: Compare full-page sequences at mobile scale against the existing campaign exemplars; check visual density and content legibility, not palette alone.

test_acceptance: All slides render at 1080 × 1350 from genuinely editable HTML/CSS/SVG.
Every slide uses exact approved SHA-256 verified canonical complete lockup.
The selected style differs compositionally from other registered families, not only by color.
Typography, contrast, safe area, asset provenance and responsive readability pass human review.
No creative or social-media publication approval is inferred.
